$comment: Plain-language, step-by-step guides shown when a door cannot take a direct (API) submission. Text is Class 8 English. Links are references, never raw URLs: url:<key> (this platform's urls), url:<platform_id>.<key>, tel:<number>, wa:<platform_id>, metro:portal|tel|wa, state:slsa|portal, app:letter|label|legal-aid|emergency|chat|offices[:type]|doc:<template>. A test checks that every url key exists in platforms.json and every phone number appears in the registry. Optional per step: states, not_states, cities.

step.call_1930_now.t: Call 1930 now. It is free and open day and night.
step.call_1930_now.label: Call 1930

step.call_1930_now.t: Tell them your bank name, the amount, the time, and the UPI or transaction number from your SMS.
In the same hour, call your bank. Use only the number printed on your card or inside the bank's app. Ask them to block your card or UPI.
Write down the complaint numbers that 1930 and your bank give you.
Then report it online on the cybercrime portal. Choose 'Report Cyber Crime'.
step.call_1930_now.label: Open cybercrime.gov.in

step.call_1930_now.t: Give your bank a written letter too. We fill most of it for you.
step.call_1930_now.label: Make the bank letter

step.call_1930_now.t: Never share an OTP, PIN or password with anyone who calls you, even if they say they are from the bank or the police.

step.police_violence_safety.t: Go to a safe place first: a friend, family member or neighbour you trust.
If you are in danger now, call 112. It is free and works from any phone.
step.police_violence_safety.label: Call 112

step.police_violence_safety.t: Women can also call the Women Helpline.
step.police_violence_safety.label: Call 1091

step.police_violence_safety.t: When you are ready, go to any police station. They must write down your complaint even if it happened in another area (this is called a Zero FIR).
step.police_violence_safety.label: Find a police station near you

step.police_violence_safety.t: You do not need to bring any papers. Ask for a free copy of the FIR.
You can get a free lawyer. Call the legal aid helpline.
step.police_violence_safety.label: Call 15100

step.police_civil_or_criminal.t: Ask yourself: did someone cheat, steal, threaten or hurt you? That is a crime, and the police handle it.
Is it only about money or property, like a loan, rent or a deal that went wrong? That is a civil matter. The police usually do not take these.
For a crime, go to the police station of the area where it happened.
step.police_civil_or_criminal.label: Find a police station near you

step.police_civil_or_criminal.t: Tell them what happened, when and where. Ask them to register an FIR and give you a free copy.
If they refuse, note the officer's name and the date. Then send your complaint in writing to the Superintendent of Police or the Police Commissioner of your city.
For a money matter, talk to a free legal adviser first.
step.police_civil_or_criminal.label: Call Tele-Law 14454

step.lost_mobile_block_and_report.t: Call your mobile company and ask them to block your SIM. Ask for a new SIM with the same number.
Find your phone's IMEI number. It is printed on the phone box and on the bill.
Report the lost phone online with the Maharashtra Police form.
step.lost_mobile_block_and_report.label: Open the lost phone form

step.lost_mobile_block_and_report.t: In Pune city you can also use the Lost and Found page.
step.lost_mobile_block_and_report.label: Pune Lost and Found

step.lost_mobile_block_and_report.t: Go to the nearest police station and give a short written report with the IMEI number.
step.lost_mobile_block_and_report.label: Find a police station near you

step.lost_mobile_block_and_report.t: Keep a copy of the police report. You need it to block the phone and to claim insurance.
From another phone, change the passwords of your email, bank and UPI apps.

step.deposit_notice_15d.t: Gather your papers: rent agreement, deposit receipt or bank entry, and photos of the house when you left.
Make the notice here. We fill most of it for you.
step.deposit_notice_15d.label: Make the notice

step.deposit_notice_15d.t: Print it, sign it, and keep one copy for yourself.
Send it by Registered Post or Speed Post from any post office. Keep the receipt.
step.deposit_notice_15d.label: Print the address label

step.deposit_notice_15d.t: Also send a photo of the signed notice by WhatsApp or email, so there is a dated record.
Wait 15 days. If nothing happens, follow the next door below.

step.wages_demand_notice_7d.t: Gather your papers: appointment letter or ID card, payslips, bank statement and attendance records, if you have them.
Make the demand notice here. We fill most of it for you.
step.wages_demand_notice_7d.label: Make the notice

step.wages_demand_notice_7d.t: Print it, sign it, and keep one copy.
Give it to your employer by hand and ask for a signed receipt, or send it by Registered Post.
step.wages_demand_notice_7d.label: Print the address label

step.wages_demand_notice_7d.t: Wait 7 days. If you are not paid, follow the next door below.

step.consumer_gro_letter.t: Find the company's customer care email or 'Grievance Officer' on its website, app or bill.
Send it by email. Keep the ticket number they send back.
You can also complain free to the National Consumer Helpline.
step.consumer_gro_letter.label: Call 1915

step.consumer_gro_letter.t: Give them about 15 days. If nothing is fixed, follow the next door below.

step.consumer_file_ejagriti.t: Keep ready: the bill, your complaint letter, and the company's reply (or proof that they did not reply).
Open e-Jagriti and sign up with your mobile number.
step.consumer_file_ejagriti.label: Open e-Jagriti

step.consumer_file_ejagriti.t: Fill in what you paid, the date, and the company name. Upload your papers.
Check everything before you submit. You cannot change it afterwards.
Save the reference number. Hearing dates are shown online.
Need help with the forms? A free lawyer can help.
step.consumer_file_ejagriti.label: Call 15100

step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo.t: Take a clear photo of the price tag (MRP) and your bill.
Ask the shop politely to return the extra money. If they refuse, give them a letter.
step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo.label: Make the letter

step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo.t: Complain free to the National Consumer Helpline.
step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo.label: Call 1915

step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo.t: Or send the complaint on WhatsApp.
step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo.label: WhatsApp the helpline

step.mrp_ask_refund_and_photo.t: Note the docket number you get.

step.civic_report_and_note_ticket.t: Take a clear photo of the problem with a shop or landmark in the picture.
Note the exact place: road name, area and a nearby landmark.
Report it to your city's complaint service. The right door below shows you how.
For garbage or public toilet problems, you can also use the Swachhata app.
step.civic_report_and_note_ticket.label: Get the Swachhata app

step.civic_report_and_note_ticket.t: Write down the complaint number. If it is closed without repair, complain again with the same number.

step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation.t: Take dated photos of the damage, like cracks, leaks or debris.
If it is safe, talk to your neighbour calmly. Then give a polite letter.
step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation.label: Make the letter

step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation.t: Ask your city's ward office to check if the building work has permission.
step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation.label: Find your ward office

step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation.t: For free mediation, call the legal services helpline.
step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation.label: Call 15100

step.neighbour_letter_then_mediation.t: Keep copies of every letter and reply.

step.cyber_harassment_save_evidence.t: Take screenshots of the messages, the profile and the link. Note the date and time.
Do not reply, and do not delete anything.
Report and block the account inside the app. Every big app has a 'Report' option.
Report it on the cybercrime portal. It has a special section for crimes against women and children.
step.cyber_harassment_save_evidence.label: Open cybercrime.gov.in

step.cyber_harassment_save_evidence.t: Tell someone you trust. You do not have to face this alone.

step.banking_lender_complaint.t: Write to your bank or lender's customer care or grievance officer. Say what went wrong and what you want.
step.banking_lender_complaint.label: Make the letter

step.banking_lender_complaint.t: Keep the complaint number and the date.
Wait for their reply. They get 30 days.
No reply in 30 days, or not happy with it? Complain free to the RBI Ombudsman.
step.banking_lender_complaint.label: Open RBI CMS

step.banking_wait_30_days.t: Keep your complaint number and the date you wrote to the lender.
When 30 days have passed, or they say no, complain free to the RBI Ombudsman.
step.banking_wait_30_days.label: Open RBI CMS

step.broker_complaint_first.t: Write to your broker or company's investor complaint email. Keep the ticket number.
step.broker_complaint_first.label: Make the letter

step.broker_complaint_first.t: If they do not solve it, complain free on SEBI SCORES. Keep your PAN ready.
step.broker_complaint_first.label: Open SEBI SCORES

step.builder_check_maharera.t: Open the MahaRERA site and search for your project's name.
step.builder_check_maharera.label: Search on MahaRERA

step.builder_check_maharera.t: Note the registration number it shows.
Keep your sale agreement, payment receipts and letters ready.
Write to the builder first, asking for possession or a refund.
step.builder_check_maharera.label: Make the letter

step.builder_check_maharera.t: Then follow the right door below.

step.builder_check_rera_registration.t: Every state has a RERA office. Your sale agreement should show the project's RERA number.
Keep your sale agreement, payment receipts and letters ready.
Write to the builder first, asking for possession or a refund.
step.builder_check_rera_registration.label: Make the letter

step.builder_check_rera_registration.t: Book a free call with a Tele-Law lawyer to find your state's RERA office.
step.builder_check_rera_registration.label: Call 14454

step.govt_apply_then_grievance.t: Find your application number and the date you applied. It is on the receipt or SMS.
If the office is late, file a free grievance on Aaple Sarkar.
step.govt_apply_then_grievance.label: Open Aaple Sarkar

step.govt_apply_then_grievance.t: If the office is late, file a free grievance on CPGRAMS. Choose your state or the department.
step.govt_apply_then_grievance.label: Open CPGRAMS

step.govt_apply_then_grievance.t: Write one clear problem and what you want done. Attach the receipt.
Save the grievance number and check the status after a few days.

step.govt_excluded_get_advice.t: Write your problem in a few lines: what happened, when, and who is involved.
Talk to a free lawyer on Tele-Law.
step.govt_excluded_get_advice.label: Call 14454

step.govt_excluded_get_advice.t: Or call the legal aid helpline.
step.govt_excluded_get_advice.label: Call 15100

step.insurance_write_to_gro.t: Find your insurance company's Grievance Officer email in the IRDAI list.
step.insurance_write_to_gro.label: Open the IRDAI list

step.insurance_write_to_gro.t: Write to them with your policy number and claim number.
step.insurance_write_to_gro.label: Make the letter

step.insurance_write_to_gro.t: Keep the acknowledgement. Wait about 15 days for a reply.
After 30 days, you can go to the Insurance Ombudsman for free.
step.insurance_write_to_gro.label: Open the Ombudsman form

step.legal_aid_screener.t: Tick the boxes that apply to you to see if you can get a free lawyer.
step.legal_aid_screener.label: Check for a free lawyer

step.legal_aid_screener.t: Call the legal aid helpline to apply.
step.legal_aid_screener.label: Call 15100

step.legal_aid_screener.t: Or visit the legal aid desk of your state or district.
step.legal_aid_screener.label: Your state's legal aid office

step.legal_aid_screener.t: Carry an ID card and a short note about your problem.

step.other_get_free_advice.t: Write your problem in a few lines: what happened, when, and who is involved.
Book a free call with a lawyer on Tele-Law.
step.other_get_free_advice.label: Sign up on Tele-Law

step.other_get_free_advice.t: No internet? Visit a Common Service Centre (CSC) near you. They book the call for you.

step.pf_keep_uan_ready.t: Find your UAN. It is printed on your salary slip.
Choose PF Member or Pensioner, enter your UAN, and type the OTP.
Describe the problem and upload any letter or slip.
Save the registration number you get by SMS.
step.pf_keep_uan_ready.label: Help: call 14470

step.posh_internal_committee.t: Write down what happened, with dates, places and any witnesses.
Give a written complaint to your workplace's Internal Committee (IC). HR can tell you who is on it.
If there is no committee, or it does not act, use SHe-Box. It sends your complaint to the right committee.
step.posh_internal_committee.label: Open SHe-Box

step.posh_internal_committee.t: If you were touched, threatened or are in danger, call 112 or go to the police.
step.posh_internal_committee.label: Call 112

cpgrams.t: Open the CPGRAMS sign-up page. Register with your name, mobile number and email.
cpgrams.label: Register on CPGRAMS

cpgrams.t: Sign in with the OTP sent to your phone.
cpgrams.label: Sign in

cpgrams.t: Click 'Lodge Public Grievance'. Pick the department, or your state.
Write one clear problem and what you want done. Attach your receipt or letter.
Submit and save the registration number.
Check progress any time with that number.
cpgrams.label: Track your grievance

cpgrams.t: No internet? Visit a Common Service Centre, or call the helpline.
cpgrams.label: Call 011-23401464

nch_ingram.t: Easiest way: call the National Consumer Helpline. Open 8 am to 8 pm, every day.
nch_ingram.label: Call 1915

nch_ingram.t: Or send your complaint on WhatsApp.
nch_ingram.label: WhatsApp 8800001915

nch_ingram.t: Choose the company and what went wrong. Enter the amount and the date.
Upload the bill if you have it.
nch_ingram.label: Upload documents

nch_ingram.t: Save the docket number. The company is asked to reply, and you can follow up with this number.

e_jagriti.t: Keep ready: the bill, your complaint letter, and the company's reply (or proof that they did not reply).
Open e-Jagriti and sign up with your mobile number and OTP.
e_jagriti.label: Open e-Jagriti

e_jagriti.t: Fill in what you paid, the date, and the company's name and address.
Upload your papers. Check everything: you cannot change it after you submit.
Save the reference number. Hearing dates are shown online.
e_jagriti.label: Check case status

e_jagriti.t: Want help with the forms? A free lawyer can file it for you.
e_jagriti.label: Call 15100

ncrp_cybercrime.t: If money was taken, call 1930 first. Every minute counts.
ncrp_cybercrime.label: Call 1930

ncrp_cybercrime.t: Open the cybercrime portal and click 'File a Complaint'.
ncrp_cybercrime.label: Open cybercrime.gov.in

ncrp_cybercrime.t: Choose 'Report Cyber Crime'. Sign in with your state, name and mobile OTP.
Write what happened in order, with dates and times. Add the money details (UTR numbers) if any.
Upload screenshots and bank statements. Give each file a clear name.
Submit and save the acknowledgement number. Use it to check your complaint later.

rbi_cms.t: First complain to your bank or lender, and wait 30 days or until they say no.
Open RBI CMS and click 'File a Complaint'.
rbi_cms.label: Open RBI CMS

rbi_cms.t: Choose your bank or lender from the list.
Verify your mobile number with the OTP. It becomes your login.
Write what happened and what you want. Upload your papers (up to 10 MB in total).
Save the complaint number (CRN) sent by SMS.
rbi_cms.label: Help: call 14448

sebi_scores.t: Register on SEBI SCORES with your mobile OTP and email.
sebi_scores.label: Open SEBI SCORES

sebi_scores.t: Click 'Register Complaint' and pick the broker or company.
Write the facts and what you want. Upload your papers.
Save the complaint number. The company must reply within 21 days.
Not happy with the reply? Ask for a review on the same site.
sebi_scores.label: Help: call 1800-22-7575

irdai_bima_bharosa_ombudsman.t: Write to your insurance company's Grievance Officer first. Find the email in the IRDAI list.
irdai_bima_bharosa_ombudsman.label: Open the IRDAI list

irdai_bima_bharosa_ombudsman.t: Wait about 15 days. Keep the acknowledgement.
After 30 days from your first complaint, file free with the Insurance Ombudsman (for claims up to Rs 50 lakh).
irdai_bima_bharosa_ombudsman.label: Open the Ombudsman form

irdai_bima_bharosa_ombudsman.t: Upload your policy, claim papers and letters. Keep file names short.
The Ombudsman first tries to settle it. If that fails, it gives a decision the insurer must follow.

maharera.t: Search your project and note its MahaRERA number.
maharera.label: Search on MahaRERA

maharera.t: Register as a Citizen on the complaint portal with email and mobile OTP.
maharera.label: Open the complaint portal

maharera.t: Choose Conciliation (Rs 1,000 plus GST, a faster friendly settlement) or a full complaint.
Pick your division, enter the project number, and upload your agreement, receipts and letters.
Pay the fee online (Rs 5,000 for a complaint) and save the complaint number.
The official guide shows every screen.
maharera.label: Open the guide (PDF)

samadhan_labour.t: Send your employer a written demand notice first.
samadhan_labour.label: Make the notice

samadhan_labour.t: Open SAMADHAN and register as a Worker with your mobile OTP.
samadhan_labour.label: Open SAMADHAN

samadhan_labour.t: Click 'Raise Dispute' and choose the problem, for example unpaid wages.
Enter the employer's name and address. Upload your notice, appointment letter and payslips.
Submit and save the Case ID. The Labour Commissioner's office will call both sides to a meeting.

mahakamgar_labour.t: Send your employer a written demand notice first.
mahakamgar_labour.label: Make the notice

mahakamgar_labour.t: Register or log in on Mahakamgar and file a complaint.
mahakamgar_labour.label: Open Mahakamgar

mahakamgar_labour.t: Or visit your area's labour office. The contact page lists them.
mahakamgar_labour.label: Labour office contacts

mahakamgar_labour.t: Go to the meeting the labour officer sets up. Bring your papers.
If the employer still refuses, the officer can send the case to the Labour Court.

she_box.t: Open SHe-Box and click 'Register your Complaint'.
she_box.label: Open SHe-Box

she_box.t: Fill in four short parts: about you, your workplace, the person, and what happened.
Write what happened (up to 500 words). Attach one file up to 2 MB if you have proof.
Submit. It goes straight to the right committee, and you can track it on the site.

epfigms.t: Find your UAN (on your salary slip) or your PPO number if you get a pension.
Choose PF Member or Pensioner, enter your UAN or PPO number, and type the OTP.
Pick the problem, describe it, and upload any letter or slip.
Save the registration number sent by SMS.
epfigms.label: Help: call 14470

aaple_sarkar_maharashtra.t: Register with your mobile and email OTP.
aaple_sarkar_maharashtra.label: Register on Aaple Sarkar

aaple_sarkar_maharashtra.t: Log in and click 'File a Grievance'.
aaple_sarkar_maharashtra.label: Log in

aaple_sarkar_maharashtra.t: Choose 'District Level' for local or city problems, or 'Mantralaya Level' for a state department.
Pick your district and department. Describe the problem and upload a photo or receipt.
Save the token number you get by SMS.
Not solved in 21 working days? Mark it 'Dissatisfied' to send it higher.
aaple_sarkar_maharashtra.label: Track your grievance

mahapolice_pune_police.t: Lost phone or documents: fill the online form with your mobile OTP.
mahapolice_pune_police.label: Open the lost phone form

mahapolice_pune_police.t: In Pune city you can also use the Lost and Found page.
mahapolice_pune_police.label: Pune Lost and Found

mahapolice_pune_police.t: For other complaints, register on the Maharashtra Police citizen portal.
mahapolice_pune_police.label: Open the citizen portal

mahapolice_pune_police.t: For an FIR, go to the police station of the area where it happened.
mahapolice_pune_police.label: Find a police station near you

mahapolice_pune_police.t: Pune City Police also take messages on WhatsApp.
mahapolice_pune_police.label: WhatsApp Pune Police

pmc_care_pune.t: Take a clear photo of the problem with a landmark in it.
Send it on WhatsApp to PMC CARE.
pmc_care_pune.label: WhatsApp PMC CARE

pmc_care_pune.t: Pick the category, mark the place, attach the photo, and save the ticket number.
Closed without repair? Reopen it with the same ticket number, or go to your ward office.
pmc_care_pune.label: Find your ward office

pcmc_grievance.t: Send a WhatsApp or SMS with your full name, address and the complaint.
pcmc_grievance.label: WhatsApp PCMC

pcmc_grievance.t: Or register on the PCMC grievance site.
pcmc_grievance.label: Open the PCMC site

pcmc_grievance.t: Save the complaint number, and check its status on the same site.

swachhata_mohua.t: Install the Swachhata app (also on the iPhone App Store).
swachhata_mohua.label: Get the app

swachhata_mohua.t: Take a photo of the problem.
Pick one of the categories and type the nearest landmark.
Submit. It goes to the local sanitary inspector.
When it says 'Resolved', check the photo. Reopen it if the work was not done.
swachhata_mohua.label: Help: call 1969

major_metro_municipal_portals.t: Take a clear photo of the problem with a landmark in it.
Open your city corporation's complaint service.
major_metro_municipal_portals.label: Open the {city} complaint site

major_metro_municipal_portals.t: Save the complaint number. If it is closed without repair, complain again with the same number.

tele_law_nyaya_bandhu.t: Sign up free on Tele-Law with your name and mobile OTP.
tele_law_nyaya_bandhu.label: Sign up on Tele-Law

tele_law_nyaya_bandhu.t: Write your problem in a few lines and pick three times that suit you.
A lawyer calls you by phone or video for about 20 minutes. It is free.
Ask what to do next, and write it down. You can ask for another lawyer if you are not happy.
No phone or internet? Visit a Common Service Centre (CSC). They book the call for you.

nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.t: Check if you can get a free lawyer. It takes one minute.
nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.label: Check for a free lawyer

nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.t: Call the free legal aid helpline.
nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.label: Call 15100

nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.t: Apply online, by post, or at the legal aid desk in your district court.
nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.label: Apply on NALSA

nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.t: Find your state's legal services office.
nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.label: Your state's legal aid office

nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.t: In Pune, the District Legal Services Authority is at the district court in Shivajinagar.
nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.label: Open DLSA Pune

nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.t: A decision and a lawyer usually come within 7 days.
For problems with public services like electricity, water or transport, you can go to the Permanent Lok Adalat before any court case.
nalsa_mslsa_dlsa.label: About Lok Adalat

maharashtra_rent_small_causes_pune.t: Gather your rent agreement, deposit proof, last bills and photos of the house when you left.
Send a 15-day notice to the landlord first.
maharashtra_rent_small_causes_pune.label: Make the notice

maharashtra_rent_small_causes_pune.t: Try free mediation through legal aid before going to court.
maharashtra_rent_small_causes_pune.label: Call 15100

maharashtra_rent_small_causes_pune.t: Still not paid? A recovery case is filed at the Small Causes Court, Shivajinagar, Pune. A free legal aid lawyer can file it for you.
maharashtra_rent_small_causes_pune.label: Pune court contacts
